# The rules engine has no AI and reads only metadata

> There is no global model reading everything because the global thing is not a model — so hallucination never enters the ranking of the user's attention.

Applies to `crates/bancada-rules/**`, `crates/bancada-meta/**`.

<!-- archwarden:yours -->

## Context

_Everything between these two markers is yours. archwarden never rewrites it._

<!-- archwarden:end -->

## Considered and rejected

- **An AI agent doing the triage** (nothing refuses it) — Flexible, and it puts hallucination in the most dangerous possible place: the order of the attention queue.
- **Rules only, no AI anywhere in the product** (nothing refuses it) — Loses pre-digestion, which is half the value, and cannot distinguish "finished" from "only reported".

## What keeps it

Nothing can. Enforced by construction rather than by a rule: `MetaEvent` has no variant that can hold content, so a leak is unrepresentable rather than forbidden. An import boundary keeping a model client out of `bancada-rules` would be a second, weaker guard on a door that has no opening. Recorded here so the guarantee is known to rest on the type, and would need a rule the day the type softens.
